playbooks.description: Stage-5 Analyze journey driving the analysis surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Analyze mode, and asserts the Analyze panel composes with the one-tap analysis actions discovered from AnalysisService.ListAnalysisOperations (Inspect/probe, Extract text/ocr, Safety check/nsfw_classify). It then loads an image and runs the default op (probe) — and because probe is the pure-Go, no-model analysis op (unlike the model-backed ocr/nsfw_classify), the run resolves SYNCHRONOUSLY to a real metadata result with NO install gate. Asserting the probe result panel renders proves the full discovery -> sync analyze edge (POST /api/v1/analysis/probe) -> AnalyzeResponse oneof parse -> structured-result render wiring works against the live API. A broken analysis-discovery RPC, an Analyze panel that fails to compose, a regressed multipart analyze edge, or a result that never renders all fail here. The model-backed ocr/nsfw_classify ops (which need an opt-in model absent in CI) surface the install gate instead — that post-install path + the on-canvas OCR detection boxes are the ATTENDED acceptance gate; the lifecycle + parsing are unit-covered by api/analysis.test, useAnalyze.test, and Workspace.analyze.test.

Stage-3 Create-hero journey driving the AI text-to-image surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Create mode, and asserts the Create panel composes with the one-tap generation actions discovered from AIService.ListAIOperations filtered to the generation category (Generate / Transform / Inpaint / Remove object). It then types a prompt and runs Generate — and because heavy generation models are opt-in downloads that are absent in CI (the headless-acceptance decision), the run resolves to the model-install gate via ModelsService.SelectModel (install.installed == false). Asserting the install gate appears proves the full prompt -> discovery -> select-model -> hardware-fit -> install-gate wiring works against the live API. A broken AI generation-discovery RPC, a Create panel that fails to compose, a SelectModel regression, or an install gate that never surfaces all fail here. The post-install N-variation generation + send-to-canvas is the ATTENDED acceptance gate (after a real model download) per docs/internal/DECISIONS.md; the lifecycle itself (submit -> WatchJob -> fetch-variations -> compose) is unit-covered by useCreate.test/Workspace.create.test.

Stage-2 Enhance-hero journey driving the AI enhancement surface end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /workspace, switches to Enhance mode, and asserts the one-tap action list is populated from AIService.ListAIOperations filtered to the enhancement category (Remove background / Upscale / Unblur+denoise). It then loads an image, selects an action, and runs it — and because heavy AI models are opt-in downloads that are absent in CI (the headless-acceptance decision), the run resolves to the model-install gate via ModelsService.SelectModel (install.installed == false). Asserting the install gate appears proves the full discovery -> select-model -> hardware-fit -> install-gate wiring works against the live API. A broken AI discovery RPC, an Enhance panel that fails to compose, a SelectModel regression, or an install gate that never surfaces all fail here. The post-install run + in-canvas result + before/after are the ATTENDED acceptance gate (after a real model download) per docs/internal/DECISIONS.md; the lifecycle itself (submit -> WatchJob -> fetch-result -> compose) is unit-covered by useEnhance.test/Workspace.enhance.test.

Smoke proof for the unified Workspace (Stage 0b): navigates to /workspace and asserts the surface composes end-to-end — the mode switcher renders, the canvas exposes its upload dropzone, and the Edit-mode operation picker is populated via OpsService.ListOperations (UI -> Connect-RPC -> internal/ops registry). A broken discovery RPC, an unmounted ops module, or a Workspace that fails to compose all fail here. Op execution + crop drag-box are covered by the Stage-1 Edit-hero journey; the multipart run edge is covered by api/handlers/ops/rest_test.go and the headless CLI acceptance in docs/internal/TESTING.md.

Stage-1 Edit-hero journey driving the humanized deterministic studio end-to-end: loads an image into the canvas, then runs a four-op edit chain through the humanized controls AND their accessible fallbacks — crop via the Advanced numeric x/y/w/h fields (the keyboard/non-pointer fallback for the canvas drag-box), adjust via the slider form, convert via a format pill, and compress via the target-size field — asserting the unified history grows one step per apply and a result image renders in the canvas. A broken OpPicker, a control that fails to wire its field into the params form, a regressed apply edge, or a history that does not advance all fail here. The crop drag-box pointer path is unit-tested in cropMath/CropOverlay; this journey pins the accessible numeric path the PRD requires for every op.

End-to-end proof that test-genie's routed test-database path actually works: navigates to a page served by the live scenario that reads from the database, and asserts that a fixture slug seeded into the per-run test pool ('routed-smoke-001') is rendered. The slug exists only in the test pool; if the API failed to route the request to the test pool (e.g., X-Vrooli-Test-Mode header not attached, TestModeMiddleware missing, RoutedDB.pick(ctx) returning the primary), the assertion fails.

Customize this for your scenario: replace the scenario_path with your DB-backed list view, the @selector/notes.list selector with your real list selector, and the slug with whatever bas/seeds/seed.go inserts into the test pool.

Stage-4 Home-launchpad journey driving the dual-mode front door end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to / and asserts the launchpad composes — the hero, the universal entry dropzone, and the intent-tile groups all render (the tile groups are built from the static op catalogs, while the recent rail + health chip exercise the live ListJobs and /health queries). It then clicks the 'Crop' Quick-edit tile and asserts the app routes into the unified Workspace (the mode switcher + canvas dropzone appear), proving the Home->Workspace intent handoff (setWorkspaceIntent -> navigate -> Workspace consumes it on mount) works against the live app. A launchpad that fails to compose, a broken tile, or an intent handoff that drops the navigation all fail here. Tile-level intent staging and the recent-rail/Library reopen are unit-covered by HomeLaunchpad.test/workspaceIntent.test.

Stage-4 Library journey driving the outputs gallery end-to-end against the real backend: navigates to /library and asserts the gallery composes — the root and the filter input render, which proves the surface derives its grid from JobsService.ListJobs (the Stage-4 contract decision: outputs come from succeeded jobs, with no separate outputs backend) without crashing. On a fresh scenario with no prior outputs the empty state renders; once jobs exist the grid renders with thumbnails. A Library that fails to compose, a broken ListJobs derivation, or a crash on empty data all fail here. Grid rendering, multi-select bulk-download, and reopen-in-Workspace are unit-covered by LibraryView.test; the reopen handoff shares the workspaceIntent path proven by home-launchpad.
